stemMarkdown: 18 workers, each working 5 hours a day, can complete a job in 18 days. How many days will 14 workers, each working 10 hours a day, take to complete the same job? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Total work $= 18 \times 18 \times 5$ worker-hours $= 1620$. With 14 workers at 10 hours/day, days needed $= \dfrac{1620}{14\times10} = 11.57$.
